title: 第21章 一鸣惊人的秦森第22章 公子世无双
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
“吴云浩！”
有人认出了这名壮硕少年。
“这是吴家的吴云浩吧？如果连他都无法通过，那么这傀儡山谷也就真没有几人能够通过了……”
显然，这吴云浩在这些年轻武修当中还是小有名气。
很快吴云浩进入傀儡山谷。
瞬间，他便是冲了出去。
他的身形虽然很魁梧，但动作一点都不慢，相反极为灵活。
差不多七十息的时间，已经冲过了一般的路程。
而这时，其中一具实力强大的傀儡冲了过来，这头傀儡接近有气海境武师的实力。
傀儡突然冲来，手臂挥动，一股劲风朝着吴云浩扑来。
吴云浩一拳轰出，和那傀儡的手臂撞击在一起。
“咚！”
沉闷的声音传来。
就像是石头撞击在铜墙铁壁上的声音。
吴云浩整个人倒飞出去，但在倒飞出去的同时，他借力往地上一拍，紧接着身子一个鱼跃，躲过了扑过来的另外几具傀儡。
接着他便是如同一道旋风一般朝着前方冲了出去。
吴云浩的这一连番动作，顿时引来一阵阵惊呼和叫好声。
接下来有差不多用了一百息的时间，吴云浩终于抵达了终点！
吴云浩通过了！
他成为了第一个通过傀儡山谷的弟子。

“天阙城，吴氏吴文浩，通过第一轮傀儡山谷考核，所耗费的时间为一百九十二息！”
随着元洪的声音落下，不少人都是朝着吴云浩投去羡慕的眼神。
许多一同前来的吴氏之人，也是激动地冲了过去，将吴云浩团团拥在其中。
吴家在天阙城，不过是一个三流家族，他们将所有的希望都放在吴云浩身上，若是这一次吴云浩能够进入天剑门，那么吴家将会在天阙城彻底翻身。
同样，在那片山坡上，凉州各座城池汇聚过来的家主或者长老当中，吴氏家主也在其中。
周围其他家族的家主或者长老，也是纷纷朝着吴氏家主送上恭贺之言。
吴云浩通过了第一轮的考核，而且时间控制在两百息之内，已经有很大的希望能够进入到前二十名。
这就意味着获得了一个进入天剑门的资格。
哪怕是成为天剑门的杂役弟子，对于这些家族而言，那都是不可多得的机会……
有了吴云浩的刺激，顿时参加考核的弟子也更加踊跃了。
但是通过率依旧很低。
半日的时间过去，将近三百个人，通过考核的也就是十几个人。
比之前预料的十个人通过一个的几率还要低！
到了夜晚，周围则是用点燃了用玉角犀牛兽的兽油制作成的兽油灯，玉角犀牛兽的兽油极为耐烧，而且点燃之后，光焰很是充足。
所以虽然是夜晚，但这片山谷却是被点亮得如同白昼。
没有人离开，都是在紧张地关注着这一次考核，即便那些失败者，也是一直留在这里，仔细思索着失败的原因，同时也是想要从更多的成功者身上学会经验，为下一次天剑门的考核做好准备。
到了午夜时分。
人群之中突然传来惊呼。
因为这次进入傀儡山谷的是雷冲！
来自于天罚城的雷冲，在这一次所有参与考核的年轻武修当中，被认为是夺下魁首的热门人选！

雷冲身形极快，一进入傀儡山谷，便展现出了之前所有考核的武修未曾展现的速度和冲击力。
最终——
雷冲抵达终点，耗时一百一十三息！
这个成绩，也是引来了一阵阵惊呼。
content_en:
"Wu Yunhao!"
Someone recognized the burly young man.
"Is this Wu Yunhao from the Wu family? If even he can't pass, then there are really not many people who can pass through this puppet valley..."
Obviously, Wu Yunhao is still somewhat famous among these young martial arts practitioners.
Soon Wu Yunhao entered the Puppet Valley.
In an instant, he rushed out.
Although his body is very burly, his movements are not slow at all, on the contrary, he is extremely flexible.
In almost seventy breaths, the average distance has been covered.
At this time, one of the powerful puppets rushed over. This puppet was close to the strength of a Qi Sea Realm martial artist.
The puppet suddenly rushed over, waving its arms, and a strong wind rushed towards Wu Yunhao.
Wu Yunhao punched out and collided with the puppet's arm.
"Boom!"
A dull voice came.
It was like the sound of stones hitting a copper wall.
Wu Yunhao flew backwards, but while flying backwards, he used his strength to slap the ground, and then made a diving jump to avoid the other puppets that rushed towards him.
Then he rushed forward like a whirlwind.
Wu Yunhao's series of actions immediately attracted waves of exclamations and applause.
After almost a hundred breaths of time, Wu Yunhao finally reached the finish line!
Wu Yunhao passed!
He became the first disciple to pass through the Golem Valley.
"Wu Wenhao of the Wu family in Tianque City passed the first round of the Puppet Valley assessment. The time it took was one hundred and ninety-two breaths!"
As Yuan Hong's voice fell, many people cast envious glances at Wu Yunhao.
Many people from the Wu family who came together also rushed over excitedly and surrounded Wu Yunhao.
The Wu family is just a third-rate family in Tianque City. They put all their hopes on Wu Yunhao. If Wu Yunhao can enter the Tianjian Sect this time, the Wu family will completely turn around in Tianque City.
Similarly, among the family heads or elders gathered from various cities in Liangzhou on that hillside, the head of the Wu family was also among them.
The heads or elders of other nearby families also sent congratulations to the head of the Wu family.
Wu Yunhao passed the first round of assessment, and the time was controlled within two hundred breaths, so he has great hope of entering the top twenty.
This means gaining the qualification to enter Tianjian Sect.
Even becoming a handyman disciple of Tianjian Sect is a rare opportunity for these families...
With Wu Yunhao's stimulation, the disciples who participated in the assessment immediately became more enthusiastic.
But the pass rate is still very low.
Half a day passed, and there were nearly three hundred people, and only a dozen people passed the examination.
The chance of one out of ten people passing was lower than previously expected!
At night, the surroundings were lit with animal oil lamps made from the oil of the Jade-horned Rhinoceros. The oil of the Jade-horned Rhinoceros was extremely resistant to burning, and when ignited, the flames were abundant.
So even though it was night, the valley was lit up like day.
No one left, they were all nervously watching this assessment. Even those who failed stayed here, thinking carefully about the reasons for their failure. At the same time, they also wanted to learn from more successful people and prepare for the next Tianjian Sect assessment.
By midnight.
Suddenly there was an exclamation from the crowd.
Because it was Lei Chong who entered the Puppet Valley this time!
Lei Chong from Tianpu City, among all the young martial artists participating in the assessment this time, is considered to be the favorite to win the title!
Lei Chong was extremely fast, and as soon as he entered the Puppet Valley, he showed speed and impact that had never been shown by any martial artist who had been tested before.
Finally——
It took one hundred and thirteen breaths for Lei Chong to reach the finish line!
This result also attracted waves of exclamations.
